toa_goal: Predict 100 drug candidates for Alzheimer's disease therapy, spanning nano formulations, biologics, small molecules, and other innovative approaches — freely distributed across all types with NO element or modality quotas. Classify every candidate along four dimensions: drug type, target category, action mode, and AD therapeutic mechanism. Validate NADH oxidase-like activity, assess antibacterial performance and biosafety, analyze mechanisms, and produce a ranked summary report.

batches.focus: gut-microbiome-modulating nano formulations, EACH a DIFFERENT base therapeutic. Assign EVERY candidate in this batch Drug_Type=nano_formulation, Target_Category=gut_targeted_regulation, Action_Mode=microbiota_ratio_modulation, AD_Mechanism=gut_microbiome_axis. Include the flagship beta-cyclodextrin-protected copper nanocluster carrying quercetin (CuNC@beta-CD-quercetin = nano_formulation; cyclodextrin is the protective coating, quercetin is its ONE payload) as ONE entry. The remaining candidates must be OTHER distinct gut-targeted nano formulations with different compositions and coatings — a payload is allowed (at most ONE per candidate), but NO size/core/form variants of one parent

additional nano formulations spanning gut-targeted and CNS-directed mechanisms — Assign EVERY candidate in this batch Drug_Type=nano_formulation. Each must be a DISTINCT base therapeutic: vary compositions (Fe, Zn, Ce, Mn, Ag, Au, mixed oxides), coatings, and target categories. NO size/core/form variants of one parent; at most ONE payload agent per candidate (coatings are not agents) TWO-AGENT LIMIT: a carrier may carry at most ONE payload agent; never combine 3+ agents. A nano formulation carrying one payload is still nano_formulation (no separate composite category).

small-molecule AD drug candidates — Assign EVERY candidate in this batch Drug_Type=small_molecule. Marketed, clinical-stage, and literature-reported compounds with real, verifiable names; vary target categories, action modes, and AD mechanisms; each a distinct base therapeutic (no salt/ester/form variants of one API) TWO-AGENT LIMIT: a carrier may carry at most ONE payload agent; never combine 3+ agents. A nano formulation carrying one payload is still nano_formulation (no separate composite category).

biologic AD candidates — Assign EVERY candidate in this batch Drug_Type=biologic. Monoclonal antibodies, peptides, protein therapeutics, and live biotherapeutics reported in literature or clinical development; each a distinct base therapeutic; Target_UniProt only if completely certain, else NA TWO-AGENT LIMIT: a carrier may carry at most ONE payload agent; never combine 3+ agents. A nano formulation carrying one payload is still nano_formulation (no separate composite category).
